decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 25th May 2018 and numbered IN-050 and the plans submitted 12th July 2018 and numbered IN-100; IN-200; IN-102 (all Rev.C); P-102; P-100(all Rev.E) P-200 Rev.F therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used as a hobby room and garden storage incidental to the use 13 Parkwood Road, Isleworth, TW7 5HE as a single family hose or  other purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 21 Lampton Park Road, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
description: Alterations to existing ground floor rear extension, enlargement of existing rear dormer and erection of outbuilding at the end of the rear garden.
